Task 85 was already shipped as v33.42 (cw-nocachelbl, commit `ee39efc6`), so I made no new change this run.

- **What the ship does:** the cache and looted words and the strongbox word are drawn only when the raid-start map is not showing. The small icons and rings stay, and so do the extract, encampment, locked room, vault, peddler, hot ground and seal labels. The in-raid m-key map is unchanged.
- **Check:** it forces 2 caches and 1 strongbox on seed 4242 and draws the map twice. With the raid-start map off, the cache and strongbox words appear. With it on, none do and the extract labels remain. The seed 4242 fingerprint held (ents 85/374, containers 165/593). I did not re-run the check this run.
- **His picture:** it shows the raid-start map (hot ground, seal, player arrow), and the cache words are the ones the guard removes.
- **Not done:** no before and after pictures at 1080 and 4K, and no critic run. The camera has no screen for the raid-start map, because screen 22 is the m-key map. Adding one means a new screen in `shots/ui-screens-js.json`, which the rules say to ask him about.
- **Question for him:** the m-key map still has cache words. His order covered only the raid-start map, so I did not log a question about the m-key map.
